intro: Our Bloom coffee table blends sleek form with graceful detail. From its tempered glass top to its floral-cut steel base, it holds your essentials and elevates your space—effortlessly.

features.title: A clear surface makes space for more
features.text: We chose strong 12mm tempered glass so you can set down your coffee, conversations, and quiet moments—without worry, and always with clarity.

features.title: Built to feel grounded and graceful
features.text: Our solid rubberwood base brings strength you can trust and a natural warmth that makes your living space feel more like home.

features.title: Designed to delight quietly
features.text: The floral laser-cut base isn’t just for show—it’s our way of adding a soft artistic touch beneath your everyday essentials.

features.title: Room for beauty and function
features.text: With a built-in MS shelf below, there’s space for the things you love—books, trays, décor—all without crowding your tabletop.

features.title: Made to fit your flow
features.text: Thanks to its clean lines and walnut finish, Bloom settles into your space with ease—never loud, always elegant.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
